source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Check SUT will take correct activity as PCIE uncorrectable non-fatal error via AMD RAS Tool 1. BIOS settings: a. NBIO Common options → ACS Enable: Enable b. NBIO Common options → Enable AER Cap: Enable c. AMD PBS → RAS → Pcie Root Port UnCorr Error Sev Reg: 7EF6030 d. AMD PBS → RAS → Pcie Device UnCorr Error Sev Reg: 7EF6030 e. FCH Common Options → FCH RAS Options → Reset After Sync-Flood: Enable f. NBIO Common Options → NBIO RAS Common Options → SyncFlood on PCIe Fatal Error: True 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Execute the following command to get a list of devices in the PCIe slots: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --listpcieslotsbdfinfo 6. PCIe Uncorrectable non-fatal Error inject to end device, enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --einjbiopcie --segment 0 --bus 65 --device 0 --function 0 --errortype 6 7. PCIe Uncorrectable non-fatal Error inject to root port, enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --einjbiopcie --segment 0 --bus 64 --device 1 --function 1 --errortype 6 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. For Uncorrectable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report. Noted: EINJ-based uncorrectable nonfatal error injection is completed by triggering PCIe Poisoned TLP error at root port or end device.

test_case.test_name: PCIe slot 1~N — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Verify uncorrectable non-fatal Poisoned-TLP handling for every required PCIe slot at both endpoint and upstream root port, with correct AER attribution, bounded transaction impact and full device/link recovery without fatal SyncFlood.
required_package: Physical slot/device serial to endpoint and upstream root-port BDF map for all targets
Endpoint class/driver/workload, active I/O and safe transaction that consumes Poisoned TLP
AMD tool/spec version/hash/license and proof errortype 6 targets the intended end/root source
Decoded `7EF6030` value/format for root-port and device Uncorrectable Error Severity plus masks/DPC/SyncFlood policy
Expected AER status/source ID/severity, application or I/O outcome and no-fatal/link-health oracle
Exact supported OS, timeout, abort, OOB recovery and BIOS/HDT restoration
test_case.test_command: Build physical-slot endpoint/upstream-port topology and device workload/dependency map; decode current AER Uncorrectable Error Severity and source masks rather than trusting `7EF6030`; capture link/AER/device state; approve a harmless transaction that consumes the poison; inject one endpoint or root-port target at a time; correlate exact Poisoned TLP status, severity, requester/source ID and process/I/O outcome; verify no fatal escalation or persistent link/device error; restore BIOS/HDT/AER state before another target.
test_case.expected_result: 1. For Uncorrectable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3.
